venues.name: D&C DC
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Thursday 3/26.** Busy night with a Garden event (event sales $5,500, 42 event guests). Every other nearby bar was closed for private events so D&C was the only one open for bar guests; moving from the jump with a skeleton crew; Sophia called in to help with the event then inside; shoutout to Sophia, Khaleel and James. Kitchen: event food went out fine and Garden guests complimented it; inside very busy with 14% of sales and nearly half the menu 86'd (shishitos - not our fault, bread & butter, Franks en croute, potatoes, cheese plate, down to a 1 count on wagyu tartare), mostly before 9pm. MOD: Cory.

venues.name: D&C EV
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Thursday 3/26.** Slow start with stuttering lulls as people enjoyed the nice weather; even at 8pm not much going on. Filled to a full room with waitlist around 9/9:30, then flooded with a small waitlist and large parties. Met guests from Toledo; Bowen tag-teamed a table wanting kosher cocktails. Comps $97.52 (1.7%). Top sellers: Material Control, Revenant, First Time Listener. Kitchen: busy night. Door (from Stef's thread reply): summery Thursday with slower gradual start; James solo at the bar early with 10-15 minute waits between seatings; Dante came in; many left for dinner reservations, slow 8pm; by 9pm patios emptied into a full house and waitlist, many medium-to-large parties; waitlist done at 11pm; 7 and 8 tops inside plus a joined 6 top at midnight; bar mostly full at 12:30. Welcomed Rochelle May (D&C LA member), Buck and friends, Connor from Portrait Bar, Chef Kyler. No-shows: Adam Priestly 2 @ 6pm; Mauricio Bohl 2 @ 10pm.
